PROJECT STONEWALL — VALUATION (MODEL v5)
Axe Capital · Deal team only

Base case: 11.0x 2027 earnings of $4.80 per share = $52.75 per share, the offer price.
Bear case: 9.5x = $45.60. Bull case: 12.5x = $60.00.
Discounted cash flow range: $49 to $58 per share (9.5% cost of equity, 2% terminal growth).
Cost synergies: $85 million a year by year two, mostly overlapping trading, risk and back-office teams. Not priced into the offer.
Walk-away price: $56.00 per share. Do not share outside the deal team.

Sensitivity: every 1x of multiple moves value by about $4.80 a share, or roughly $290 million of equity.

Python model: stonewall_valuation.py in the deal folder.
